# GXEON Paid APIs

> Pay-per-request JSON validation and CSV data-quality auditing for software and AI agents.

## Canonical endpoints

- JSON Validate: POST https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/x402/json-validate
  - Price: 0.01 USDC per request
  - Network: Base mainnet (CAIP-2: eip155:8453)
  - Service ID: gxeon_json_validate_v1
  - Input: JSON object with payload (any JSON value or raw JSON string) and optional lightweight schema.
- CSV Audit: POST https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/x402/csv-audit
  - Price: 0.01 USDC per request
  - Network: Base mainnet (CAIP-2: eip155:8453)
  - Service ID: gxeon_csv_audit_v1
  - Input: JSON object with csv string, optional delimiter and hasHeader.
  - Output can report qualityPass=false while still being a successfully delivered audit.

## x402 v2 payment flow

1. Send POST with Content-Type: application/json and no payment header.
2. Receive HTTP 402 and decode the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header from base64 JSON.
3. Sign the exact terms in the challenge using an x402 v2-compatible wallet/client.
4. Retry the same POST body with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
5. On HTTP 200, retain PAYMENT-RESPONSE, X-402-Receipt, X-402-Settlement and the JSON receipt.

Never create a second payment to recover a pending delivery. For HTTP 503, retry only with the same request body and original PAYMENT-SIGNATURE as instructed by the response. If delivery remains unavailable, contact support with the transaction hash; never share signatures or authorization secrets.

## Examples

### CSV Audit
```bash
curl -i https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/x402/csv-audit \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"csv":"id,name\\n1,Ana\\n2,","hasHeader":true}'
```

### JSON Validate
```bash
curl -i https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/x402/json-validate \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"payload":{"ready":true},"schema":{"type":"object","required":["ready"],"properties":{"ready":{"type":"boolean"}}}}'
```

## Machine-readable specification

- OpenAPI 3.1: /openapi.yaml
- This file: /llms.txt

## Reliability and commercial status

A quote (HTTP 402) is not a completed sale. Count revenue only after on-chain settlement is independently verified and the service returns its result with a receipt. A data-quality finding (for example qualityPass=false) is a valid delivered result; an HTTP 503 after payment is not.

The public API listing and prices do not guarantee third-party discovery, buyer demand, or revenue. Check live service readiness before enabling paid traffic.
